column2: Country-level arboviral transmission and vaccine-access classifications
195 sovereign states assessed independently for DENV, CHIKV, JEV, and YFV (780 country-virus records).
A preserved 249-country/territory dataset is included for sensitivity analyses.
This workbook provides the country-level classifications, operational definitions, analytical decisions, evidence inventory, and summary statistics supporting the analysis.
The unit of analysis is the jurisdiction. Vaccine approval, availability, and programme deployment do not measure population coverage or protection.

Every record includes explicit transmission and vaccine source IDs. Global or regional backbone sources are listed for all records; country-specific sources are added only where directly identified. Absence of a country-specific source is stated explicitly and is not treated as proof of regulatory or programme absence.
